decisive_steps.step: Upper bound via the top Stiefel–Whitney class (final §§1).
decisive_steps.checked: The equivariance gives precisely the stated associated vector bundle. Its top class is x^j y^j(x+y)^j. For n=2^{s−1}, j=2n−2, the monomial x^{3n−2}y^{3n−4} has odd coefficient and survives when d=3n−2. The sign-integral map is continuous by dominated convergence, including at constant affine functions; a zero supplies four nonempty convex sign regions.

decisive_steps.step: Construction of 2n−2 symmetric positive-definite forms with no nontrivial common orthogonal pair (final §2).
decisive_steps.checked: Checked the polynomial-factorization argument over C: vanishing remainders force f=αu and g=βv for complementary real monic factors of the squarefree polynomial p. The last two forms force both real and imaginary parts of conjugate(α)β to vanish. The form Re(i f*Kg) is indeed symmetric over R. Independence of each factor pair makes the forbidden conditions on K proper hyperplanes; the explicit integer choice also satisfies leading-term dominance. Retaining the identity form makes shifting the other matrices by a large multiple of I preserve the common-zero exclusion.

Each bisecting hyperplane must contain all Gaussian means, forcing its normal into the final n coordinates. Four-way Gaussian equipartition forces zero covariance for the two defining linear forms, contradicting the constructed matrices. All covariance matrices are positive definite. Projection and lifting correctly establish monotonicity in dimension.

contract.form: A complete answer must give an explicit exact formula for D_s valid for every integer s ≥ 3, and establish that this is the least dimension in which every collection of 2^s − 2 measures admits the required simultaneous four-way equipartition by two affine hyperplanes.
contract.not_enough: Upper or lower bounds, a range of possible dimensions, an unknown or undetermined status, a formula conditional on a conjecture, or exact values for only some s do not settle the question. An existence result in a proposed dimension without establishing its minimality is also insufficient.
